text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
...I was looking at the training camp 
lodge. We learned so much here, didn't we?

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
I've trained a lot with you... and 
steadily built up my strength.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
...No, we'll definitely talk about this 
later. More importantly, right now—

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
"Let us head there with heads held high. 
To the 'Tenno Sho (Autumn)', where Father 
and Mother await—"
